text:
mei: Quick sync  we're shipping a short nurture series tied to the benchmark webinar next Wed. Need final segment file, subject variants, and send windows by EOD.

carlos: Suggest timezone splits: APAC early, NA midday, EMEA evening. Local send windows: 9am / 11am / 4pm local.

rhea: Segments (draft CSV):
```
segment_id,filter,notes
trial_recent_3d,trial_start<=3d,high intent new trials
engagers_21d,last_open<=21d,active users
lapsed_180d,last_engagement>180d,reactivation cohort
```
Exclude tag `no_email` and unsubscribes in last 30d.

ops_bot: Quota check: daily cap 1M. Ops recommends concurrency 160, batch 120. If provider 5xx > 2% for 5m, auto-failover to backup provider.

mei: Creative ask: two subject directions ) benefit-driven B) curiosity-led. Keep preheaders short. Olga, can you draft?

olga: Draft subjects: 1) "How Redwood cut token cost & latency" 2) "What we measured across 1000 runs". Preheaders: "Webinar + checklist" / "Benchmarks + configs". Also one short curiosity line: "We found a surprising bott" for lapsed cohort.

carlos: A/B plan: engaged users 70/30 A/B; trial_recent_3d: 60/20/20 across three variants (add a trial-first subject). lapsed_180d even split.

rhea: Drip cadence: initial -> 36h reminder -> 4-day reminder -> post-webinar recap. For trial_recent_3d shorten to 24h -> 48h.

mei: RSVP gating: include one-question survey (use-case) and route replies to SDRs. Add UTM params: utm_campaign=orbit_bench&utm_medium=email&utm_source=campaign.

carlos: I'll export segments and drop to s3://marketing/orbit/segments_final.csv by EOD. Ops, please confirm pull path.

send-bot: File upload detected: s3://marketing/orbit/segments_final.csv. Verifying header integrity and sample sizes.

ops_bot: Confirmed. Scheduling job epoch 1732176000. Plan: 160 concurrent, batch 120, ramp 12m. Failover file: s3://marketing/orbit/fallback.csv. Add soft pause: region "EMEA" if bounce_rate>2.5% over 30m.

olga: One more creative note: subject for new trials should mention "get started in 10 mins". Short CTAs in button and first paragraph.

mei: Great. @carlos please pin final send plan in #marketing + attach the CSV. Debrief Fri 9am PT to review opens/clicks/register-to-attend. Thanks team :rocket:
